text:
payments-bot: Automated alert: invoice INV-4721 for Acme Corp failed to charge card (decline code: card_declined). Attempt 1.

maria_finance: saw this — customer on annual plan. I emailed them earlier today, no reply yet.

sam_support: customer replied in support thread: says their card expired and they want to pay by wire ASAP. Asked for wire instructions.

maria_finance: OK, can we provide wire details and schedule a retry once they confirm? Also need to disable auto-cancel until EOD. @julia_accounting can you hold off on dunning? :pray:

julia_accounting: holding dunning for 48h. please cc accounting when they confirm wire. Also note: we'll mark invoice as "pending - wire" in bookkeeping.

raj_sales: pinged Acme AM on the call, they're willing to expedite. If they wire today we can accept and apply immediately. No need to pause service.

maria_finance: sharing wire template below (masking acct #s). Please use this verbatim and ask customer to include INV-4721 as payment reference.

```
Bank: First Example Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account: ****6789
Routing/ABA: 111000025
SWIFT/BIC: EXAMPLExxx
Reference: INV-4721
```

sam_support: forwarded template to customer at 14:22 PT, asked them to reply when transfer initiated.

julia_accounting: when wire arrives, paste the bank deposit confirmation here and I'll reconcile. If they ask for an invoice PDF, send the attached invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-4721

maria_finance: scheduling one retry on card for 18 hours from now in case they want to try card after updating details. If wire comes in before that, I'll cancel the retry.

payments-bot: Note: scheduled retry set for 1745217856 (18h). Will attempt automatic charge then.

raj_sales: thanks all — keeping thread open until settled. :thumbsup:

julia_accounting: noted, will update ledger after reconciliation. If wire fails or not received by EOD +2, escalate to legal for collections.
